messages:
hana: Heads-up from the design review: Bulk annotate in the Eval scorecard is confusing. People accidentally approve examples when they meant to tag. We need clearer affordances.

liam: Can we split the bulk toolbar into two distinct sections: 'Select actions' (tag, label, export) and 'State actions' (approve, unapprove)? Visual grouping should reduce misclicks.

paz: Also recommend adding a confirmation step only for destructive state actions (approve/unapprove) and not for tagging. Confirmation UI should show counts and a short consequence line.

marc: Keyboard users report that space toggles the checkbox but also scrolls the page. We should intercept space on focused row checkbox only and preventDefault. Also add 'a' shortcut for annotate and 'v' for approve.

aria-bot: a11y-scan: ensure the bulk toolbar has role="toolbar" with aria-label="Bulk actions" and use aria-disabled for non-applicable actions. Also recommend aria-live for the bulk action result message.

hana: Microcopy: change CTA 'Apply' to context-aware labels: 'Apply tags', 'Apply label to selection', 'Approve selected examples'. Avoid generic verbs.

liam: For mobile, the toolbar overflows. Suggest collapsing into a single ellipsis menu with the top 2 actions shown and the rest inside. Ensure primary destructive action is buried to avoid accidental taps.

paz: When tagging, show inline toast that lists what changed, e.g., "Added tag 'spam' to 12 examples" with an undo CTA. Undo scope should be per action and last 10s.

marc: Implementation note: bulk operations operate server-side; show optimistic UI but show a progress indicator and per-item failure count. If any fail, open a small drawer listing failures with per-item retry.

aria-bot: a11y-scan: toast notifications must be accessible (role="status") and not trap focus. Confirm dialog must be role="dialog" with focus trap and descriptive heading e.g., "Approve 120 examples?" and a short paragraph.

pm-sam: Product note: sponsoring change is OK but add a feature flag for rollout to power users first. Also log metric for accidental approvals (clicks on approve with selection < 3) to measure improvement.

hana: Decision summary: split toolbar visually into Select vs State groups, use explicit CTAs per action, confirmation only for approve/unapprove (threshold > 1 or always? propose threshold > 1), keyboard shortcuts (a annotate, v approve) with a help popover, intercept space on checkbox, collapse toolbar on mobile with overflow menu, add undo toast for tag actions, show progress + failure drawer, and add a feature flag for staged rollout.

liam: I'll push a prototype with updated grouping and keyboard help. Will include accessibility attributes per aria-bot notes.

paz: I'll draft copy for confirmations and toasts and post to the i18n channel for translations.

marc: I'll add keyboard handling to the component PR and include tests for preventDefault behavior.

hana: Thanks all 44d  please tag me on PRs.
